entries.title: Psalms 75:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician; set to Al-tash-heth. A Psalm of Asaph; a song.>> We give thanks unto thee, O God; We give thanks, for thy name is near: Men tell of thy wondrous works.

entries.title: Psalms 75:2
segments: When I shall  find the set time, I will judge uprightly.

entries.title: Psalms 75:3
segments: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I have  set up the pillars of it. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 75:4
segments: I said unto the  arrogant, Deal not arrogantly; And to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:

entries.title: Psalms 75:5
segments: Lift not up your horn on high; Speak not  with a stiff neck.

entries.title: Psalms 75:6
segments: For neither from the east, nor from the west, Nor yet  from the  south, [cometh] lifting up.

entries.title: Psalms 75:7
segments: But God is the judge: He putteth down one, and lifteth up another.

entries.title: Psalms 75:8
segments: For in the hand of Jehovah there is a cup, and the wine  foameth; It is full of mixture, and he poureth out of the same: Surely the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall drain them, and drink them.

entries.title: Psalms 75:9
segments: But I will declare for ever, I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 75:10
segments: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; But the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.
